findings.text: the delivered-work match reads candidate.get("phase") or candidate.get("status"), but history is now ledger.picker_runs whose rows are projected through _PICKER_FIELDS (reckon/ledger.py:1702-1726) which carries neither key, measured on the live store as zero of 20 rows having phase or status; so phase is always the empty string for a stored row and the failed/stopped/interrupted/discarded/dropped exclusion can never fire, and a section whose only run failed its gate is now skipped as an existing run instead of being queued again.

the discarded-run case passes because crew.discard removes the pointer and writes no store row, so the section is queued by absence rather than by the phase exclusion; a stored run whose gate failed is the case that would exercise the exclusion and it is not covered, which is why the regression above passes the node's own gate.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_landed_section_is_not_queued_again.py for two cases; both exist and the scoped gate log scoped-gate-1795340146325948711.log records 60 passed in 40.52s closing EXIT=0 at 83196da7.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal in docs/plans/a-reviewed-plan-is-queued-at-full-width.html:98 is that a plan-level dispatch does not queue a section whose run has landed, naming that run; reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:840-853 now reads delivered work from ledger.picker_runs and matches on plan+section, and the new test shows a landed section reported skipped with its run id.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, both suite arms (58 passed at base, 60 passed at head, both EXIT=0) and negative-control.log closing EXIT=1 with `assert 'queued' == 'skipped'` over `'queued': 2`.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py, the new test, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; the diff touches the first three and nothing outside them.

justifications.evidence: the negative control at dde7b001 is executed and logged with the exact assertion that fails, and the scoped gate and both suite arms are recorded with revision, command and EXIT at scoped-gate-1795340146325948711.log:8.
justifications.fit: the change uses the ledger's own picker_runs and row_plan and adds a docstring paragraph in the surrounding voice at reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:794-803, with no new symbol or banned name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:840-853 skips the landed section by name as the goal requires, but the same match now treats every stored row as delivered because ledger.picker_record drops phase and status from the picker projection.
justifications.reuse: no new definition is added; the change extends the existing ledger owner (reckon/ledger.py:1923 picker_runs and :1987 row_plan) rather than re-implementing a delivered-work read.
